asset.name: fern_leaves
asset.description: Generate a PRODUCTION PART SHEET preserving the exact supplied Java fern / Microsorum pteropus plant's PIXEL ART drawing finish and painted green material. Exact 3 columns by 2 rows, pure white, NO grid lines, text or labels. Each equal cell contains ONE complete isolated LEAF BLADE with a short petiole stub, petiole DOWN and tip UP; every blade fully in cell with white margin and clear gaps. Six unique whole simple lanceolate blades from the same plant: tall mature gently waving upright blade; longer slightly twisted blade; broad mature lanceolate blade bent outward; thinner arching leaf; shorter young simple lanceolate leaf; older gently drooping blade. They are long, not wide Anubias leaves: length-width ratio around 6–8 for most leaves, never a feather frond. Subtle irregular whole margins, coherent bright central vein and secondary veins, dark forest green planes, muted olive highlights matching the original master. Keep distinctive source-painted folds and silhouette bends, no uniform green noise. No whole plant, roots, rhizome, pot, water or overlap across cells. These complete painted silhouettes will be traced as individual thick 3D leaf meshes. No material swatches. IMPORTANT: exact same individual Microsorum pteropus and same painted style as reference. Isolated on pure white with generous white margin; no ground, cast shadow, labels or text. Keep all tips fully visible.

plan.prompt:
Subject: Six unique whole Microsorum pteropus leaf blades from one plant, each isolated with a short petiole stub: tall gently waving mature blade, longer slightly twisted blade, broad mature lanceolate blade bent outward, thinner arching leaf, short young lanceolate leaf, older drooping blade.
Silhouette: Lanceolate, length-to-width about 6–8, never feather fronds or broad Anubias shape; subtle irregular whole margins, source-painted folds and bends, every blade complete with tip fully visible and generous white gaps between cells.
Style lock: Soft style alignment with art direction; prefer cohesive look over literal copy.; Match supplied master: naturalistic detailed pixel art, coherent painted green volume, crisp deliberate clusters, dark forest green planes with muted olive highlights, bright central vein and secondary veins; no uniform green noise, no CGI or photographic texture.
View: Side view, profile facing right, readable silhouette for side-scroller gameplay; Side view, flat orthographic profile, blades facing viewer, petiole down and tip up within each cell.
Technical: Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), uniform studio backdrop; single object centered; mattable still; no environment scenery; Pure flat white #FFFFFF studio backdrop, exact 3 columns by 2 rows, six equal cells, no grid lines, no border, no vignette, no ground shadow, no environment, no text or labels.
Negatives: No spritesheet; no multiple action frames in one image; never transparent background or checkerboard; No whole plant, rhizome, roots, pot, water, substrate, leaf overlap, grid lines, labels, text, material swatches, checkerboard or fake transparency, cast shadows, feather fronds, wide leaves, cropped tips.
negative_hints: Do not prompt for transparent background or checkerboard.
Do not include multiple characters or action frames.
Do not include borders, frames, vignettes, gradients, or textured backdrops.
Character sprite only — not a prison scene, not environmental background, not item icon.
No prison walls, bars, cells, floors, or scenery behind the character.
